entries.name: 관우
entries.identity: Guan Yu, the SECOND figure from the left in reference 1. Mounted in ALL THREE views. Deep emerald green tall cloth cap with gold band and central gold ornament, long black beard, stern thick black eyebrows, emerald robe and gold shoulder armor. Exactly the same crescent guandao: dark pole, broad silver crescent blade, gold collars, red tassel, gold butt spike, held in his RIGHT hand (viewer-left in front view; viewer-right in rear). Chestnut horse with dark mane and tail, dark hooves, gold bridle and decorative breastplate; match the front horse in reference 1 and approved rear horse in reference 2. Preserve compact chibi horse proportions, no tall realistic horse. Profile MUST show the horse's complete nose, tail, four articulated legs and all four hooves with subtle leg staggering, rider seated correctly.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving character turnaround.
Asset: one clean production reference sheet for an already-approved Korean pixel-art Three Kingdoms chess game. This is NOT a character redesign.
Input roles: reference 1 is canonical initial character lineup (front identity/style); reference 2 is THIS character's already approved independently drawn rear sprite; reference 3 is approved battle preparation UI (in-game scale, simplicity, silhouette reference ONLY, never cut anything from it).
Create THREE newly drawn full-body views of ONLY the specified same hero in one horizontal row, LEFT = exact straight FRONT, CENTER = exact straight REAR, RIGHT = true LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE. All three at identical bodily scale, same head size, same footwear/hoof baseline, same equipment dimensions; do not enlarge the side view to fill space. Mild elevated orthographic game camera consistently across views, not dramatic perspective.
STYLE LOCK: faithfully retain the charming compact chunky pixel-art of reference1 and reference3: large expressive head, short sturdy limbs, deliberate hard square pixel clusters, dark navy outlines, limited 3-4 stepped shades per material, warm gold highlights. No smooth vector, no painterly rendering, no 3D, no photorealism, no fine high-frequency texture. Enlarge pixel clusters crisply for this reference sheet, no blur. Front appearance must be recognizably identical to original lineup, rear closely tracks the already approved sprite. Side is a coherent rotation of the very SAME design.
Transparent alpha background, no scenery, no floor, no checkerboard painted in, no shadow, no labels/text/UI/frames/diamonds/stars. Wide landscape sheet approximately 1536x1024 or equivalent. Three clearly separated evenly spaced columns. Fit complete silhouettes with at least 8% outer margin and wide transparent gutters. Every spear tip, pole butt, feather, cape corner, sleeve, fan, foot, horse muzzle/tail/leg/hoof must be fully inside the canvas and its own column. Never crop, never overlap the adjacent figure. Prioritize uncut silhouettes and identity over filling canvas.

entries.name: 허저
entries.identity: Xu Chu, the FIRST figure from the left in reference 1. One short dark handled round gray spiked mace in his RIGHT hand, low beside body (viewer-left in front, viewer-right in back). Preserve front identity and stocky width exactly; do not add cape, horse or helmet.
